# Packet — ani-015-b: Spell 15 — the hymns, part 2 of 4

Established from Budge 1895, pp. 127–131. Start: {"page": 127, "plate": "XIX", "line": 1, "note": "“1. ànet' ḥrà - k χabes em Àn …” (“Homage to thee, [lord of] starry deities in Àn …”, p. 127 row 3, under the rule: the litany of Chapter XV), right after ani-015-a's “ḥeḥ t'etta” (p. 127 row 2, end of the hymn to Osiris)"}. End: {"page": 131, "plate": "XX", "line": 15, "lastWord": "neb - à", "note": "… may I be united to the land of everlastingness; thou, behold, hast ordered for me it, my lord. (p. 131 row 9, second word; the rest of the row, “à Àusàr Ani maāχeru em ḥetep maāχeru t'eṭ - f” “Hail Osiris, Ani, … he saith:”, opens the speech that runs on to p. 132 l. 16 and is the next part)"}.
Left out as not Ani's text: p. 129 footnote 1 (“For a similar text see Lepsius, Todtenbuch, Bl. iv.”; its mark stands in the PLATE XX title row).
